name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The princes of Zoan are fools, and the counsel of the wise counselors of Pharaoh is become brutish.

“Surely the princes of Zoan are fools.” Zoan was one of the major cities of ancient Egypt, so the princes are the leadership in ancient Egypt, and they were fools, just like today. “The counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish”: brutish is stupid.

“How say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?” That is what the leadership here in America does. They say, we’re the sons and daughters of the ancient leaders. There’s a movie that just came out called Them, and in it there is a white girl that gives a rundown to stir all the people in the community up: our ancestors built America, our ancestors are the wise ones. That’s the same thing it’s saying here.

note.label: : SABBATH EVENING CLASS | Deliverance From Egypt, Then and Now

points: “Surely the princes of Zoan are fools”: Zoan was of Egypt. Those princes are the same ones in verse 3, the charmers, them that have familiar spirits, and the wizards. “The counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish”: become stupid. Now we know who those princes and wise counsellors are: the president’s cabinet, the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the people he sits down with to be advised on what to do and what not to do.

“How say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?” How can you come to the president and say, I’m the son of wise men of ancient times, my bloodline goes way back? The Lord don’t give a damn about that.

note.label: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

points: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt. Egypt now is America; this America is the shadow of Egypt. We trusting in their politics, their policies, their decrees. They talking now about merging militaries for their wars, and none of it has anything to do with us. We running to them for help and they cannot help us; they don't want to help us.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: “To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt”: they trusting America. They think America gonna fix them; that’s what it means to trust in the shadow of Egypt.

note.label: The Guide to Fixing a Broken People

points: “That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” This literally took place: we went down to ancient Egypt for help and trusted in it. But it says the shadow of Egypt, so it is not the real Egypt we are trusting in but its shadow. It is twofold: our people trusted in America, because America is the new Egypt.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh”: that is talking about America. “And to trust in the shadow of Egypt”: we trust in this system. Democrat, Republican, we trust in this system, and we think it’s never going to happen here. A lot of us are comfortable in this system.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”: this literally did happen, but our people today have not asked of the word of God. “To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh”: that is America. “And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” See that part: Revelation says this place is spiritually Egypt, and Isaiah here says the shadow of Egypt.

Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame. We have to come out of this place mentally, spiritually, physically. I ain't talking about physically leaving it yet; I'm talking about coming out of these false holidays and these customs they set up to make us think we are part of it, when we not.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame: That's why we still get shot down in the streets. That's why Trump is passing all these tariffs and shipping all these so-called Cubans, Venezuelans, Haitians back to their country. So now you shame. You went hard trying to prove and uphold this system. You voted. Now he's saying, Oh, you thought I was on your side. Oh, now reality struck.

Leaning to Pharaoh's strength instead of the Most High turns their trust into shame and confusion. There were times kings sought the Most High, and times they sought heathen kings to fight their battles for them.

note.label: Isaiah 30: Woe to the Rebellious Children Who Trust in Egypt

points: “Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame”: the government gonna be your shame. “And the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion”: trusting in America and its policies, America’s religion, all these things set up, is going to be your confusion. This is why a lot of pastors are confused, a lot of preachers, ministers, and these damn women prophets; go to the clubhouse and listen to them sometime, they have no idea what they talking about.

note.label: The Guide to Fixing a Broken People

points: “Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame.” The strength you look for in the president is going to be a shame. You trusted in America, and it will be a shame for all of you who went to vote and supported Trump, or Biden, or Kamala. You are going to realize these people can’t save you.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.” The trust you have in this system is going to be your shame. Eventually people are going to start running into your house looking for food. You ain’t seen nothing yet.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame”: the strength of Pharaoh is America today, the spiritual Egypt, and this place shall be our people’s shame. “And the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion”: trusting in this shadow of Egypt, this spiritual Egypt, shall be our utter confusion.
